Hadith.2413 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) said:
"No man entrusts his family with a guardianship better than praying two units of prayer before leaving for a journey

and saying:
'O Allah (swt), I entrust You with my soul, my family, my wealth, my offspring, my worldly affairs, my Hereafter, my trust, and the conclusion of my deeds.'
No one says this except that Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, grants them what they have asked for."
